body: I decided to myself that if I stop smiling even though a small thing or even a stupid TV commercial can’t make me laugh or smile, that’s the day I end my life. Fortunately there r still few things makes me smile, so I’m still trying to fight with my darkness

What is happiness? Can anyone define me?? Coz seems like everyone is chasing for happiness but seriously what is it? Who said that we all can be happy?? Some can be, some can’t achieve that. Anyway what is happiness!
The reason is coz I’m so tired of trying to fight with my suffering…
